response.answer: The National Gallery in London will feature Monet's "The Beach at Trouville" as the Picture of the Month for September 2026. Additionally, Monet's "Bathers at La Grenouillère" will be part of the Renoir and Love exhibition, displayed alongside Pierre-Auguste Renoir's "La Grenouillère," marking the first time in 19 years that these works are shown together. The gallery also includes Monet's "The Water-Lily Pond" among its permanent collection.

For a limited period, Claude Monet's Bathers at La Grenouillère and Pierre-Auguste Renoir's 'La Grenouillère' (both 1869) will be displayed together at the Gallery for the first time in 19 years. Painted side by side from a very similar viewpoint, the works capture a defining moment in the birth of Impressionism, offering a first glimpse into the artistic friendships, emotional storytelling and spirit of experimentation that will be explored throughout 'Renoir and Love'.
